why: A single misread digit, 2 -> 5, invisible to any check that asks who won: Harvey wins on either figure. It shows up as arithmetic that cannot happen -- the ward blocks are single-seat with blanks printed, so each block equals its wards ballots, and 1162 exceeded the ward pairs 862 by exactly 300 while the six other wards matched their at-large precinct columns to the unit. why: Derived, not printed, so it is weaker evidence than a stated seat count would be. Ballots are 6639, from the seven single-seat ward councillor blocks (blanks printed, each equal to its wards ballots) summing to exactly that once Ward Four is corrected -- a derivation independent of any num_winners. 19917 = 3 x 6639 exactly and 26556 = 4 x 6639 exactly, so Councillor At Large at 4 is right and School Committee at 5 is not; at 5 the block would have to close at 33195.
